title: Summit 4S Tent
content: Four-season two-person mountaineering tent for winter camping. Price 389 USD. Weight 3.2 kg. Rated to minus 25 degrees Celsius and wind gusts up to 90 km/h. Double-wall design with snow skirt and reinforced pole sleeves.

title: Trailhead 2 Tent
content: Three-season two-person backpacking tent for spring, summer and early autumn. Price 229 USD. Weight 1.9 kg. Not rated for snow load. Ventilated mesh canopy and a single vestibule.

title: Ridge Family 4 Tent
content: Three-season four-person family tent with two doors and a stand-up porch. Price 299 USD. Weight 5.4 kg. Suitable for car camping in mild weather.

title: Glacier -15 Sleeping Bag
content: Down sleeping bag comfort rated to minus 15 degrees Celsius. Price 199 USD. Weight 1.6 kg. Water-resistant shell and a draft collar for winter trips.

title: Meadow 5 Sleeping Bag
content: Synthetic sleeping bag comfort rated to plus 5 degrees Celsius. Price 89 USD. Weight 1.2 kg. Machine washable and quick drying.

title: Pathfinder 45L Backpack
content: Forty-five litre trekking backpack with adjustable torso length and a rain cover. Price 159 USD. Weight 1.4 kg.

title: Ember Compact Stove
content: Compact canister stove that boils one litre of water in three and a half minutes. Price 59 USD. Weight 85 grams. Works down to minus 10 degrees Celsius with a winter canister.

title: Nomad Trekking Poles
content: Pair of carbon trekking poles with cork grips and quick-lock adjustment. Price 79 USD. Weight 440 grams per pair.
